invariants.name: reorderable_position_set_invariance
invariants.description: For each prime p, the set of positions occupied by dishes divisible by p is fixed; reordering only permutes elements within this set while non-divisible positions stay unchanged. Consequently, for any prefix length k, the number of divisible dishes in the first k positions equals the original count of such dishes with index < k. The maximum achievable prefix sum is obtained by placing the largest divisible values into these fixed prefix slots, leading to a replacement rule using descending-order prefix sums and the original prefix sums.
